claims: As of March 20, 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage refinance rates hovered around 6.25% to 6.79%.
As of March 20, 2026, 15-year fixed mortgage refinance rates sat between 5.5% and 5.91%.
As of March 19-20, 2026, 30-year fixed refinance rates were 6.16%–6.79%.
As of March 19-20, 2026, 15-year fixed refinance rates were 5.50%–5.91%.
As of March 19-20, 2026, 20-year fixed refinance rates were 6.12%–7.75%.
As of March 19-20, 2026, 5/1 ARM refinance rates were 5.49%–7.33%.
As of March 19-20, 2026, VA/FHA 30-year refinance rates were 5.375%–6.22%.
